description: Tool to get a Salesforce org's active theme and directory of supported objects. Use when you need to discover available objects that are supported by the User Interface API, including their CRUD permissions, labels, and theme information.

q.description: Comma-separated list of object API names to filter the response. When provided, only returns metadata for the specified objects. If omitted, returns all available objects.
q.title: Q

name: get_supported_objects_directory

GetSupportedObjectsDirectoryResponse.description: Response containing directory of supported objects and active theme.

eTag.description: Version identifier for caching and conditional HTTP requests.
eTag.title: E Tag

objects.description: Map where keys are object API names (e.g., Account, Contact) and values are object metadata entries.
objects.title: Objects

themeInfo.description: Object containing color and icon information for the active theme.
themeInfo.title: Theme Info

GetSupportedObjectsDirectoryResponse.title: GetSupportedObjectsDirectoryResponse

ObjectInfoDirectoryEntry.description: Metadata entry for a single object in the directory.

apiName.description: The API name of the object.
apiName.title: Api Name

createable.description: Whether new records can be created.
createable.title: Createable

custom.description: True if custom object, false for standard.
custom.title: Custom

keyPrefix.description: Three-character prefix used in record IDs.
keyPrefix.title: Key Prefix

label.description: The user-facing display label for the object.
label.title: Label

labelPlural.description: The plural form of the object label.
labelPlural.title: Label Plural

layoutable.description: Whether the object supports page layouts.
layoutable.title: Layoutable

queryable.description: Whether the object can be queried using SOQL.
queryable.title: Queryable

searchable.description: Whether the object can be searched using SOSL.
searchable.title: Searchable

themeInfo.description: Theme information specific to this object.
themeInfo.title: Theme Info

ObjectInfoDirectoryEntry.title: ObjectInfoDirectoryEntry

ThemeInfo.description: Theme information containing color and icon details.
